description: This file defines the CalendarSyncInterface, which is a PHP interface declaring methods for calendar synchronization, provider validation, configuration, scheduling, and account management in the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: CalendarSyncInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for calendar synchronization and integration functionalities for external calendar providers within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Synchronizes all calendar accounts; can be manual or scheduled.

methods.name: syncAllMeetingsOfCalendarAccount
methods.description: Schedules all meetings for a specified calendar account.

methods.name: syncMeeting
methods.description: Synchronizes a given Meeting object with external calendar systems.

methods.name: syncEvent
methods.description: Executes a calendar sync job from serialized scheduler data.

methods.name: getProviderAuthMethodWithValidation
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the authentication method for a given calendar source.

methods.name: testProviderConnectionWithValidation
methods.description: Validates and tests the connection to a calendar provider.

methods.name: getFieldsToHide
methods.description: Determines which UI fields should be hidden based on the calendar source.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves all calendar sync configuration values.

methods.name: getConflictResolutionCases
methods.description: Provides conflict resolution options for calendar sync.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the scheduler instance responsible for calendar sync tasks.

methods.name: getActiveCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Fetches all active calendar accounts linked to a specific user.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to the CalendarSync implementation.
